regulator.name: Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados (ANPD)

instruments.name: Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais, Lei nº 13.709/2018 (LGPD)
Marco Civil da Internet, Lei nº 12.965/2014

facet_hints.legal_bases: The LGPD has ten legal bases in Article 7, more than the GDPR; do not assume a one-to-one mapping.
facet_hints.dpo: The LGPD requires an encarregado (DPO) with published contact details.
facet_hints.cross_border: Article 33 international transfer conditions and the ANPD standard contractual clauses.
facet_hints.breach_notification: Article 48 communication to the ANPD and to data subjects.
facet_hints.enforcement: Search ANPD sanction decisions and guidance.

seed_obligations.title: Establish one of the ten legal bases for each processing operation
applies_when: processes personal data in Brazil or of individuals in Brazil

seed_obligations.title: Appoint an encarregado and publish their contact details
applies_when: is a controller under the LGPD

seed_obligations.title: Communicate security incidents to the ANPD and affected data subjects
applies_when: a security incident that may create relevant risk or damage occurs
testable_as: an incident runbook naming the ANPD

seed_obligations.title: Meet a condition for international transfer of personal data
testable_as: a recorded transfer condition per destination
